snippet.title: Principia Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Principia is the successor to the Android-hit Apparatus, played by over 3 million players. Use the laws of physics to guide the robot to the goal. Build advanced constructions in the sandbox editor using an advanced electronics system and over 150 unique objects.

Get it now:
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bithack.principia

Available NOW on Android phones and tablets, coming soon to Linux, Windows and iOS.

Music:
"Pixel Peeker Polka - faster" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
